svg.aria-label: Step-by-step mechanism of the aldol condensation of ethanal
svg.title: Step-by-step mechanism of the aldol condensation of ethanal

g.text: Mechanism of the aldol condensation of ethanal (dilute NaOH)
Step 1: hydroxide removes an α-hydrogen → resonance-stabilised enolate ion
Step 2: the nucleophilic carbon of the enolate attacks the C=O of a second ethanal (C–C bond formed)
Step 3: protonation by water gives the aldol (3-hydroxybutanal) and regenerates the catalyst, OH−
Step 4 (on heating): dehydration by the E1cB route gives the α,β-unsaturated aldehyde
